            Baseline that compounds

            Protein · sleep · consistency

            Vision

            A simple, repeatable floor: high-protein / low-carb intuitive eating, consistent sleep window, daily walk or yoga, and staying off alcohol/tobacco because your body now rejects them. Not optimization theater — just the platform everything else sits on.

            Science / why

            Protein + resistance preserves muscle in a deficit. Morning light and walks support circadian rhythm and serotonin. Alcohol disrupts sleep architecture and recovery; your recent acute negative reactions are useful signal, not failure.

            Recommended next steps

            • • Protect one non-negotiable: e.g. 10–15 min walk or yoga most days
            • • Keep protein high and carbs intuitive — no need for perfect tracking
            • • Treat alcohol/tobacco as closed experiments for now

            Your notes

              Movement (hand-aware)

              Legs · yoga · walks

              Vision

              Train around the left-hand constraint: prioritize legs, posterior chain, walking, swimming, and yoga. Upper-body work stays light or post-PT. Goal isn’t a PE peak — it’s durable energy, mood, and a body that can still build a cabin someday.

              Synergies

              Lower-body strength + walks feed the nature-escape habit. Yoga doubles as stress/mental reset. Consistent movement makes the supplement stack optional, not primary.

              Paths

              • • Minimum: 2–3× lower-body or yoga + daily short walk
              • • Weekend: one longer hike or ski day when schedule allows
              • • Hand path: keep Seattle PT plan on the radar; don’t force bench/press patterns

              Your notes

                Supplements & bio support

                Mag · D3 · Omega-3 · Creatine · Protein

                Current stack (from our talks)

                Core candidates: Mag glycinate, D3/K2 or D3, Omega-3, protein as needed. Optional / situational: MCT or mushroom coffee, curcumin, glucosamine+MSM, probiotics, L-glutamine, B12, green tea extract, sleep aids (magnesium, low-dose melatonin, or 5-HTP only if needed). DIY mushroom blends (Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Cordyceps, etc.) as a cheaper Mud Wtr-style option.

                Science-backed stance

                Prioritize deficiencies and recovery (D, mag, omega-3, protein). Treat the rest as experiments with a clear “stop if no benefit in 4–6 weeks” rule. Hand/joint support (curcumin, glucosamine) is reasonable while waiting on PT/surgery planning.

                Recommended next steps

                • • Keep the core small; don’t run 12 things at once
                • • If trying mushrooms, start with one blend and note energy/focus for 2 weeks
                • • Revisit stack after bloodwork or post-hand-plan if you get labs
